question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

CNY : GRC :: FRL : JVP :: ITK : ?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d7fd46426f00ba56b91d423458faa673503496b14e50413ec14eae6a6e84c211.png] 

The logic followed here is :-

 
• CNY : GRC

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f36ac39a47fe3ef4577abc430a79b5debb3175c6b64b9685c2dd0b5032ad7a8e.png] 

and

 
• FRL : JVP

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ece57b83f1487b8ba3613eb7ba715e828d1884b320c82415165b7cb3e0043d97.png] 

Similarly,

 
• ITK : ?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bb7f1b8d3b8d0ed237421c9f080eb989d0801ea2d5c74f0e74e06bdf9d15329a.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"MXO".**
